title: Enode x SAP: SAP has chosen Enode to enable residential flexibility within SAP Distributed Energy Resources
summary: Energy retailers are moving from experimentation to long-term decisions about residential flexibility. Today, flexibility needs to operate as part of day-to-day business, not as a side initiative. SAP sees that shift clearly. That’s why SAP has chosen Enode to enable SAP Distributed Energy Resources, a solution supporting residential distributed energy resource (DER) flexibility within SAP environments. The partnership brings Enode’s full product capabilities into the SAP ecosystem, allowing utilities to manage residential flexibility with the same operational discipline they apply to the rest of their business.
